subject: reasoning
question: W started walking straight from her office to go her home. During her journey she turned 7 times right and 6 times left. She is finally walking towards north to reach her home. In which direction she started walking?
solution:
Given: 

W started walking straight from her office to go her home.

During her journey she turned 7 times right and 6 times left.

She is finally walking towards north to reach her home.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fa971776cf3e1f4607faa9026a12af23a07266be9901c144a0f55da25a198c7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47743949d8c350c0fe207e806d4b53a54450c61133be0964358220b705ec46cb.png] 

So, She started walking West.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
